method.geometry: Exact POSITION values, triangle indices and primitive topology after resolving actual GLB accessors; index/byte-offset numbering does not enter the fingerprint
method.transform: Exact recursive glTF scene world matrices, including parent TRS or column-major matrices; no tolerance applied
method.render_attributes: Normals, tangent, UV and vertex-color fingerprints plus material-name bindings are reported separately and do not substitute for geometry identity
method.ordering: Strict per-primitive vertex/index ordering; a failure can mean representation reordering and requires inspection before claiming a geometric displacement
method.scope_limit: Geometry/pose regression only; this does not verify furniture support or grant final visual acceptance
